operators.name: custom_softplus
semantics: Computes element-wise softplus: y = log(1 + exp(x)).
Matches torch.nn.functional.softplus with default beta=1, threshold=20: y = x for x > threshold, else log1p(exp(x)) for numerical stability.
Preserves input shape, dtype, device, memory layout (contiguous or strided as input).

operators.name: custom_sum_dim1
semantics: Computes sum over dimension 1 (of size 64) with keepdim=True.
Result shape [32, 1, 192, 512], same dtype and device.
Output tensor should be contiguous as produced by usual reduction; dim=1 is normalized.
Element-wise softplus as defined in torch.nn.functional.softplus(x, beta=1, threshold=20).
Input shape [32, 64, 192, 512] float32 CUDA; output same shape.
Sum over dimension 1 with keepdim=True, resulting shape [32, 1, 192, 512].
